result.notes: "Paygent Connect" could not be located as a distinct, documented product. The precomputed unauth_api_probe (paygent.com) and docs_page lookups both returned empty/status 0, and no vendor developer-docs site was found across 5 searches and 3 fetches. www.pay-gent.com resolves but has no substantive content. The name most plausibly refers to an NMI white-label reseller/ISV storefront (hint: 'NMI-powered'); NMI itself gates its v4 API behind an active merchant account obtained through a certified reseller/partner ('NMI doesn't typically sell directly to merchants; it distributes its gateway through certified partners and resellers' — per search summary of nmi.com/paymentcloudinc.com, not independently verified with a direct quote), meaning even if Paygent Connect is that reseller, API access would require partner/merchant onboarding rather than self-serve signup. Distinct from the unrelated Japanese 株式会社ペイジェント (Paygent Inc.) payment gateway and from newer 2026 'Paygent' AI-agent-payment startups (paygent.tech, paygent.net, paygentcommerce.com, withpaygent.com) — none of which match the NMI hint. MCP registry hits (com.obsmetrics.paygent/agents, io.github.djautomd-lab/aipaygent) appear to belong to these unrelated AI-agent-payment projects, not to an NMI-powered Paygent Connect, so mcp.status is reported unknown rather than official. Given the inability to find real developer documentation, this is reported as red/undocumented with low confidence rather than guessing at unverifiable details.
result.one_liner: Paygent Connect appears to be an NMI-powered ("white-label") payment gateway/reseller offering, but no independently verifiable, vendor-published developer documentation site could be located for it.
